testimonials.title: What early centres usually want fixed first

items.title: No more scattered student lists
items.description: Owners can keep students, guardians, classes, and enrolments in one workflow instead of separate sheets.

items.title: Attendance is faster
items.description: Teachers can open Today, create sessions, and mark all students present before adjusting absences or lateness.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Short answers for tuition centre owners evaluating {appName}.

items.question: Is {appName} for parents and students too?
items.answer: Not yet. The MVP is for owners, admins, and teachers. Parent/student portals can come later.

items.question: Can parents pay tuition through {appName}?
items.answer: For MVP, tuition payments are recorded manually. Stripe is used only for the centre's {appName} subscription.

items.question: Does it support Bahasa Malaysia?
items.answer: The marketing site supports English and Bahasa Malaysia. The authenticated app is being localized progressively.

items.question: Can I import existing students?
items.answer: Yes. Admins can import students and guardians using the CSV template in the Students page.

items.question: What happens after the trial?
items.answer: Choose Starter, Pro, or Max from Billing. If a trial or subscription is inactive, new record creation is limited until billing is resolved.
